description:
*** YOU NEED TO KNOW HOW TO SWIM - THIS IS AN SPORT EXPERIENCE ***

We will meet in our place in the magical district of Poblenou, 5 min walk to the beach. We will walk together with our paddlesurf boards to the beach.

1. We will meet the group till the time to catch the sunrise! BE PUNCTUAL, WE HAVE TO GO IN ORDER TO CATCH THE SUNRISE!
2. We will teach you how to paddle from the beach to the ocean.
3. You will learn how to stand up!
4. I will give you a few tips to manage the paddle, its super easy! You dont need previous experience at all but you need some sport skills.
5. While we are in the water I will take you some cool pictures with sun rising and Barcelona's skyline for free, is the best view! they are included but you need tone close us!

At the end we will go back to our store to leave the board, change your clothes, we have showers and toilets too and we will send you the pictures of the experience.

You can check all the activities that we offer: yoga, supyoga, fullmoon events, functional beach trainings and sup seawalks.
hostdescription: I'm Laia from Barcelona, I love the sea, sports, photography and travel. I was born next to the ocean in Poblenou District (Barcelona) and I love to get the chance to show my beautiful city and its beach to different travelers from around the world and know them!!!! :)
locationDescription:
Msr Bella beach in Poblenou. Barcelona. We meet in our place BARCELONA BEACH HOUSE Sup & Yoga, in Poblenou: Time before was a industry and fisherman's barrio and now we have the opportunity to swim and enjoy now the beach in this area of the city because now become's on one of the coolest barrio of the city.
From the sea we could see perfectly the skyline of Barcelona.

reviews.text: I had an amazing time in Barcelona beach. Thank you. If you have pictures that we all 5 are in, could you send me by app ‪+ (Phone number hidden by Airbnb) ‬ ?
It was a very nice experience, but the current was very strong so some people couldn't keep up. Maybe its better to arrange groups by experience

I would recommend it to anyone looking to paddle in an exceptional setting.
The instructor is at your disposal if needed and the outing is done in a good mood, everyone keeping their pace.

It's an experience that marks my stay in Barcelona!

This experience was absolutely wonderful. Laia and her partner were incredibly accommodating with scheduling my experience (I missed my first time and they were responsive and kind about rescheduling me for a different time). I also really appreciated how many individual pictures were taken and that these were sent to me in high resolution (having the great pictures is the best part!). It was magical to paddle and watch the sunrise.

Some important things to be aware:
1) As the hosts mention, ability to swim is a must. Someone who couldn't swim tried joining the group and was turned back (100% agree with this decision, as this was made very clear in the description and isn't safe).
2) The meeting time was listed a bit earlier than we actually started, so there was a 15 minute grace period for those who came late (or waiting time for those who were there early).
3) Personal phones can't be taken on the water in this activity for safety - don't worry, they take amazing and high resolution pictures so this isn't an issue, just something to be aware of beforehand.

Overall, I have to give this 5 stars. It was an excellent experience and a great value, and I loved it. Would highly recommend to anyone in the area!!
It is an unusual and great experience to get to know the the beauty of Barcelona in the morning. It's hard to find an experience like this one with regular tour agencies. Thanks Laia

Loved the experience! Undoubtedly one of the greatest moments of my stay in Barcelona!
Maca was an amazing host every step of the way!
Beautiful location, talented and experienced guides, and views you can’t get anywhere else, this is experience Is worth way more than you pay! Would do it again!

Unimaginable trip! An amazing adventure against then becoming friend with water! Thanks for Laia’s help to get more understanding for controlling the pivot

This was an amazing and beautiful way to start the day. If you think you will be able to stand up without falling over, you are sorely mistaken hahaha so much fun!

Will do iy again a few more times. Also the free pictures were great.

This was so much fun and cannot recommend enough. We made new friends from other countries, had the best time paddle boarding (1st time ever), and had great pictures to capture the memory. Do it!!!

this is an adventure you shouldn't miss when in Barcelona. at first I wasn't sure if it would be good before I've never done this before. but it's not a problem as everything can be done in your own pace. Also the photos became gorgeous. thank you!!

I like and enjoy it so much! It would be nice to track which months are more windy so we can already know how hard it can be or that the photos won't have a clear sunrise. Apart from that, the experience is amazing!

While the team has tried the best, the experience sadly was not as great as it looked, and this feeling was shared among the others I’ve talked to from the same day. Understandably, the weather and conditions are outside of the team’s control, but the experience itself fell out of expectations.

Firstly, I believe the team of 2 took on more people in a group than they could handle. This caused them and us enormous stress, and negatively impacted the experience. At times, they shouted and scolded members of the group (myself included). They did not have enough time and capacity to care for the group, especially when they were many paddlers who were first timers and in the bad conditions described. This also meant not everyone got pictures taken, and a lot of time was spent waiting for the instructors to finish helping other people in the group, and not much paddling time at all to enjoy the water.

Secondly, the level of preparedness but the team was not ideal. By the time we were in the water, the sun was already up. We arrived on site when the sky was completely dark, and we really didn’t get to see the beautiful sunrise as part of the experience.

Thirdly, photography. There actually 2 types of photography - a photographer is invited to take pictures, which you need to pay for yourself later on. Or, Laia’s team would take photos on her phone - which is airdropped later. However, it did at one point feel like we were completing a mission to take photos - and did not get to enjoy the paddling activity itself.

I have really looked forward to this activity, seeing all the great reviews for this experience. While I appreciate the efforts Laia and team have put in to ensure the safety of this activity, sadly, I would not recommend anyone to participate in this experience as it fell short for me personally. Sure, the weather and condition was bad and I cannot blame this on the host, however, perhaps a cancellation/ reschedule, or even a better instructor to group ratio would have helped the experience (having 1 instructor to 10 almost newbies in rocky waves is not a good idea).

Next time I come to Basse, I will try to stand up, it's more comfortable!

Both hosts are super nice and very patient to teach those who’ve never paddle boarded before (including me!)

Truly an amazing experience. It was our first time on paddle boards. Laid and Maca were wonderful. They explained the activity very well and took amazing pictures. Views of the sunrise were magical. I would highly recommend this excursion!
Amazing experience in Barcelona! The sunrise was extremely beautiful, and Laia was so nice and took a lot of pictures for everyone. One of the best memories in Barcelona ❤️

Very nice staff, unfortunately we missed the actual sunrise paddeling experience because our taxi was late but once they came out of the water they gave us stand-up paddles to go on our own which was a good compromise (although we of course would have liked to go on the actual paddeling planned) , afterwards they also gave us loads of tips on what to do in Barcelona and where to eat. This was an amazing experience. It was amazing to be on the water on the paddle board and see the sunrise! Watching the sun rise from the sea is magical. The silent and sudden explosion of colour! Thank you for giving me that experience, Laia! This sunrise SUP was amazing!! Such a beautiful location, a great addition to a Barcelona trip!! The guide is so kind and takes lots of pictures. It feels very peaceful and safe.

I'm glad I went ahead with the tour and am very pleased I was matched with Laia. thank you Laia!

Amazing!! Totally worth it, they teach you with patient and you can easy get the way of it. The pictures are really nice.

Great experience, beautiful beach and sunset, and Laia is really nice, we didn't swim well, they let us paddle in shallower seas, no safety issues. And I can guarantee that they don't have any racism, my experience as a Chinese is very good.
It was a very nice experience and brought a lot of fun and muscle pain. The tips in the aftermath of Barcelona were also great.

It was a once-in-a-lifetime experience watching this special city from the sup sunrise! I would book it again and again:)
The hosts were so lovely and very supportive, they ensured everyone would be okay despite the conditions of the water. It was so peaceful and magical, would definitely recommend!

This was a wonderful experience all around! Laia and her crew are so welcoming and kind and helpful. Really cool experience! We met a lot of awesome people from different parts of the world and Laia brought us together with her jokes. We were constantly smiling and laughing helping each other capture our photos. The sunrise was beautiful and the water felt nice and calming. Would do it again!
it's my first time to try the paddle boarding and it is wonderful！ to enjoy the sea and sunrise in the morning！and the coaches are wonderful and caring！
